purpose: Populate the existing laser-source contract with traceable screen values without presenting unqualified laser hardware or plasma-coupling assumptions as measured results.

selected_screen_basis.name: latest_CAD_A2_reference_screen
selected_screen_basis.interpretation: For a steady profile with dW/dt = 0, P_total_absorbed_heating_required_W is mapped to the reported modeled-loss power. This makes the external laser requirement zero on this branch; the laser remains a transient/startup and perturbation source rather than a required steady-state heat source.

alpha_self_heating.qualification_note: The 0.90 deposition and 0.10 escaped-alpha values are the model branch used to reproduce the screen, not orbit-resolved qualified transport results. Keep the qualified replacement open.

plasma_heating_balance.formula: P_external_laser_absorbed_required = max(0, P_total_absorbed_heating_required - P_alpha_to_plasma - P_RF_absorbed - P_other_absorbed)
plasma_heating_balance.boundary_note: P_RF_absorbed_W and P_other_absorbed_W are set to zero only because this handoff is the laser-only balance. They are not measurements of the complete reactor.

laser_conversion_and_wall_loss.eta_laser_to_plasma_nominal_context: EV-009 nominal absorption on a 100 micrometer ramp
laser_conversion_and_wall_loss.eta_laser_to_plasma_optimized_context: EV-009 inverse result at 629.05 micrometer ramp and 2 keV background; validation open
laser_conversion_and_wall_loss.important_separation: The unabsorbed fraction 1 - eta_laser_to_plasma is only an upper bound for liquid-wall deposition. It cannot be assigned to fraction_stray_laser_to_liquid_wall without beam tracing, aperture loss accounting, and a resolved target/corona/wall map.

prescribed_pulse_wall_screen.case_selection: Separately prescribed optical-on pulse train, not steady supplemental-heating requirement.
prescribed_pulse_wall_screen.component_wall_energy_condition: Component bounds assume the same fixed nominal coupling and maximum transfer for both pulse components; component-resolved coupling is not established.

required_wall_energy_tally.requirement: Use the same shot, optical reference plane, geometry revision and beam/component schedule for numerator and denominator. Direct laser absorption at the liquid wall excludes plasma radiation, alpha, neutron and gamma energy.

pulse_definition_required.pulse_duration_semantics: Gaussian FWHM of the long preconditioning component in the recovered notebook waveform preset.
pulse_definition_required.fast_spike_duration_semantics: Gaussian FWHM of the fast spike in the recovered notebook waveform preset.
pulse_definition_required.duty_factor_semantics: Existing component duty_factor fields equal FWHM times repetition rate, not true finite-support on-time for a Gaussian. The combined timing-dependent duty remains unresolved.

source.name: TOMAHAWK_Verified_Quick_Run.ipynb
source.transfer_note: Only the documented pulse split and waveform preset are recovered here. Notebook coupling of 0.86 is not silently substituted for this contract's nominal coupling of 0.268574.

peak_power_coefficients.semantics: Legacy field names: these expressions are E_component / FWHM power scales, or rectangular-pulse peaks if explicitly using a flat top. They are not normalized Gaussian peaks.

normalized_gaussian_component_peaks_scre.normalization: 801 uniformly spaced samples per component; normalize exp(-0.5*(t/sigma)^2) by its trapezoidal time integral. Component peak equals its energy divided by that integral.
normalized_gaussian_component_peaks_scre.sigma_rule: sigma = component_FWHM / 2.355, matching the notebook preset
normalized_gaussian_component_peaks_scre.timing_note: These are individual component peaks, not a combined transient or local wall heat flux. Component delay and per-port timing remain unresolved.

alternate_rev2_4_active_profile_case.interpretation: This branch is the one that produces a nonzero steady external-laser requirement. Its loss values are rounded in the prior review and must not be combined with the later CAD-A2 reference-screen values.

remaining_blockers: qualified laser-to-plasma coupling law for the actual CAD target/corona state
fraction of uncoupled laser energy that reaches the liquid wall
target-specific validation or optimization of the recovered 50/50 pulse preset
beam origins, directions, polarization, focus and spot-size schedule
background bremsstrahlung, synchrotron and other-radiation wall source maps
vendor or facility evidence for 10 Hz, 2.50 MJ/module operation
module-scale wall-plug efficiency and thermal-duty qualification
solver_guards: Do not substitute wall_plug_efficiency_target for eta_laser_to_plasma.
Do not substitute 1 - eta_laser_to_plasma for fraction_stray_laser_to_liquid_wall.
Do not treat 0.268574 or 0.860024 as qualified coupling.
Use recovered f_pre = f_spike = 0.50 for the documented screening preset only; do not claim it is a validated or optimized target pulse split.
E/FWHM power scales are not normalized Gaussian peaks.
Keep the selected CAD-A2 balance and the Rev2.4 legacy balance as separate cases.
Keep peak power, pulse energy and cycle-average power as separate variables.
